audience: fitness studios and fitspot operators that run their class schedule in fitDEGREE

useCases.title: Check the schedule and the classes
useCases.text: List the locations, then the bookable sessions of one location, and the classes they belong to.

useCases.title: Review the bookings for a session
useCases.text: List the bookings with their status. Then list the members to match the names.

useCases.title: Track recent sales
useCases.text: List the sales of memberships, passes and other items, with the member for each sale.

useCases.title: Match instructors to sessions
useCases.text: List the team members with their active flag. Then match them to the sessions of the schedule.
